summary.text: Ryan Foster is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democrat Kelly Garrett.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary, which he won over Ronald Ulmer-Paul.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Foster was born in Southfield, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Ferris State University in 2002.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes work in transportation and policing, and he served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 2016 to 2019.
Foster appears on Ballotpedia as a candidate in the 2022 Democratic primary for Michigan State Senate District 7, in which incumbent Jeremy Moss defeated him.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was running as a write-in candidate in Michigan's 12th Congressional District.
